title: Roadmap to the platinum
note: Eight steps in the order a first playthrough should meet them. Only one flag on the whole road is a point of no return: the meditation watch in step 1. Everything else can be cleaned up after the story.

steps.title: Touchdown in Leonida
steps.summary: The opening hours: finish Chapter 1, take in Ocean Beach while you are there, and start the one habit this roadmap insists on - meditating at every spot the first time you reach it.
steps.effort: The opening chapter; a couple of hours
steps.point_of_no_return_note: Positive Mental Attitude is the list's one missable watch: PowerPyx and U7Buy flag that a Chapter 1 meditation spot may not be reachable later. Meditate on arrival, every time, from the very first spot.

steps.title: First threads
steps.summary: Chapter 2 and the first named missions, and the moment to open the stranger strands: Strangers & Freaks counts eight finished strands, so every strand started early is one less to chase at the end.
steps.effort: Early story plus the first side strands

steps.title: The middle chapters
steps.summary: Chapters 3 and 4 with the missions that sit inside them. Keep meditating on arrival and keep the stranger strands moving between story beats.

steps.title: Big scores
steps.summary: The heist heart of the game: the Cartel Heist, the VCIA operation and Savage Glory in the story, and the free-roam scores - bank vaults, an armored truck and one clean jewelry job - while your crew and loadout are at their strongest.
steps.effort: Late-story missions plus five vaults and two roadside jobs

steps.title: Loose ends for friends
steps.summary: Close out the named strands: the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and Bret's unique-animal hunt. Each finale carries its own trophy and feeds the Strangers & Freaks count from step 2.
steps.effort: Six side arcs, each a few missions

steps.title: Leonida pastimes
steps.summary: The activity belt: ranges, races, stunts, fishing, bowling, partner trouble and gang work. Most of these open early and ripen slowly - sample everything for Master of None, then grind the counters (250 stunts, 20 race wins) a few at a time between missions.
steps.effort: Spread across the whole playthrough; the stunt counter is the long pole

steps.title: The completionist sweep
steps.summary: The collectors' pass: card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 vehicles, every corner of the map, the money totals and the garage keys - plus the four cryptic trophies whose covering habits (showroom exits, instant retries, staying for strange events, partner play) should already be second nature by now.
steps.effort: The longest step; mostly travel and tally-keeping

steps.title: Endgame and the platinum
steps.summary: Finish the final mission, close the last percentage points of the completion counter, and the platinum follows the 54th trophy on its own. If anything is still open, the tracker board is the checklist - nothing on this road is missable except the step 1 watch you have already kept.
steps.effort: The finale plus whatever the sweep left behind
